# Button

Header: `winui/ui/input/Button.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/input/Button.hpp`.

A push button, clicked by mouse (press and release inside), Enter/Space while focused, or UI Automation's Invoke.

Shows either a plain [text()](#text) label, whose color tracks hover/press/disabled automatically, or arbitrary [set_content()](#set_content) (an icon plus text, say). A click runs, in order: the attached [flyout()](#flyout) toggles open or closed, the protected [on_activated()](#on_activated) hook, the [on_click()](#on_click) handler, the command ([set_command()](#set_command)), then [navigate_uri()](#navigate_uri) opens if set. The look comes from [variant()](#variant) and the theme, with per-instance background / foreground overrides. Not final: [ToggleButton](toggle-button.md#uitogglebutton) and [DropdownButton](dropdown-button.md#uidropdownbutton) derive from it through the protected hooks.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};

auto       stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto*      label = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Clicks: 0"));
ui::ButtonControl* go = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Click me"));
go->set_variant(ui::ButtonVariant::Accent);
go->on_click([label, n = 0]() mutable { label->set_text(std::format("Clicks: {}", ++n)); });
window.set_content(std::move(stack));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{.text = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); })},
        ui::Button{.text = "Click me", .variant = ui::ButtonVariant::Accent,
                          .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; }},
        ui::Button{.text = "Docs", .navigate_uri = "https://example.com/docs",
                          .variant = ui::ButtonVariant::Hyperlink},
    },
});
```

## `ui::Button`

A push button. Builds a [ui::ButtonControl](#uibuttoncontrol).

[`.text`](#uibutton-text) is the label; [`.content`](#uibutton-content) replaces it with any subtree (an icon beside text, say). A click runs [`.on_click`](#uibutton-on_click), then [`.command`](#uibutton-command), then opens [`.navigate_uri`](#uibutton-navigate_uri). With a [`.command`](#uibutton-command) the button is enabled only while both [`.enabled`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) and the command's [`enabled`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) allow it, and an unset [`.tool_tip`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) falls back to the command's description.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};
ui::Property<bool> dirty{false};
ui::Command       save{.enabled = dirty, .execute = [&] { save_document(); }};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::Button{.text = "Click me", .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; }},
        ui::Button{.text = "Save", .command = save}, // enablement comes with the command
        ui::Button{.variant = ui::ButtonVariant::Accent,
                   .content = ui::HorizontalStack{
                       .spacing  = 8,
                       .content  = {ui::Icon{.source = ui::glyphs::More}, ui::Text{.text = "More"}},
                   }},
        ui::Button{.text         = "Docs",
                   .navigate_uri = "https://example.com/docs",
                   .variant      = ui::ButtonVariant::Hyperlink},
    },
});
```

```cpp
    .text, .navigate_uri, .variant, .padding, .background, .foreground, .style, .margin,
    .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .command,

    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .content
}
```

| <span id="uibutton-variant"></span>`variant` | `ui::Binding<ui::ButtonVariant>` | `{ui::ButtonVariant::Neutral}` | Neutral, Accent, Subtle or Hyperlink ([ui::ButtonControl::set_variant()](#set_variant)). |

| <span id="uibutton-background"></span>`background` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | The fill at rest ([ui::ButtonControl::set_background()](#set_background)): a fixed color or a theme resource, which follows theme switches. Unset keeps the style's. |
| <span id="uibutton-foreground"></span>`foreground` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | The label color at rest: a fixed color or a theme resource, which follows theme switches. Unset keeps the style's. |
| <span id="uibutton-command"></span>`command` | `ui::CommandRef` |  | A shared, named action (ui/Command.hpp), run after [`.on_click`](#uibutton-on_click) with [`.command_parameter`](#uibutton-command_parameter). The button is enabled only while both the command and [`.enabled`](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec) allow it, and follows the command as it changes. Written as the command itself: [`.command = save`](#uibutton-command). |
| <span id="uibutton-command_parameter"></span>`command_parameter` | `std::string` |  | Handed to [`.command`](#uibutton-command) when it runs. |
| <span id="uibutton-on_click"></span>`on_click` | `ui::Action` |  | A completed press and release inside, or Enter/Space while focused. Runs before [`.command`](#uibutton-command). |
| <span id="uibutton-on_context_requested"></span>`on_context_requested` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(std::optional<ui::Point>)>` |  | A context menu was requested ([Element::on_context_requested()](../tree/element.md#on_context_requested)). Returning nothing, or [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled), means a menu or flyout was shown; [ui::NotHandled](../core/namespace-ui.md#nothandled) lets the request go on. |
| <span id="uibutton-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uibutton-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uibutton-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uibutton-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uibutton-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |

| <span id="uibutton-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::Button>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uibutton-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | Arbitrary content instead of a plain label, such as an icon plus text. When set it replaces [`.text`](#uibutton-text) for layout and rendering entirely. |

## `ui::ButtonControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`, `ui::InvokeProvider`.

A push button, clicked by mouse (press and release inside), Enter/Space while focused, or UI Automation's Invoke.

Shows either a plain [text()](#text) label, whose color tracks hover/press/disabled automatically, or arbitrary [set_content()](#set_content) (an icon plus text, say). A click runs, in order: the attached [flyout()](#flyout) toggles open or closed, the protected [on_activated()](#on_activated) hook, the [on_click()](#on_click) handler, the command ([set_command()](#set_command)), then [navigate_uri()](#navigate_uri) opens if set. The look comes from [variant()](#variant) and the theme, with per-instance background / foreground overrides. Not final: [ToggleButton](toggle-button.md#uitogglebutton) and [DropdownButton](dropdown-button.md#uidropdownbutton) derive from it through the protected hooks.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int> clicks{0};

auto       stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto*      label = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Clicks: 0"));
ui::ButtonControl* go = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Click me"));
go->set_variant(ui::ButtonVariant::Accent);
go->on_click([label, n = 0]() mutable { label->set_text(std::format("Clicks: {}", ++n)); });
window.set_content(std::move(stack));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{.text = ui::bind(clicks, [](int n) { return std::format("Clicks: {}", n); })},
        ui::Button{.text = "Click me", .variant = ui::ButtonVariant::Accent,
                          .on_click = [&] { ++clicks; }},
        ui::Button{.text = "Docs", .navigate_uri = "https://example.com/docs",
                          .variant = ui::ButtonVariant::Hyperlink},
    },
});
```

### ButtonControl

```cpp
ButtonControl() = default
```

A button with an empty label.

### ButtonControl

```cpp
ButtonControl(std::string text)
```

A button labeled [`text`](#text) (UTF-8).

### text

```cpp
const std::string& text() const
```

The plain-text label (UTF-8), drawn centered in the current state's text color, so it tracks hover/press/disabled automatically. Also the automation name fallback. Ignored once [content()](#content) is set.

### set_text

```cpp
void set_text(std::string text)
```

Sets the label (UTF-8). The button is measured again and redrawn.

### set_content

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_content(std::unique_ptr<T> content)
```

Any [Element](../tree/element.md) as content in place of the text label, e.g. a [StackControl](../layout/stack.md#uistackcontrol) of an icon and a [TextControl](text.md#uitextcontrol). Takes ownership, destroys any previous content, and returns a non-owning observer, as [StackControl::add()](../layout/stack.md#add) does. When set, content replaces [text()](#text) for layout and rendering. The caller picks the content's colors, because the state's foreground color only applies to [text()](#text). [`content`](#content) must not be null. The button is measured again and redrawn.

### content

```cpp
Element* content() const
```

The content set with [set_content()](#set_content) as a non-owning observer, or nullptr for a text button.

### variant

```cpp
ButtonVariant variant() const
```

The token set the button draws with; ButtonVariant::Neutral by default.

### set_variant

```cpp
void set_variant(ButtonVariant variant)
```

Redraws only; every style has the same metrics.

### set_padding

```cpp
void set_padding(std::optional<Thickness> padding)
```

The padding around the text or content, DIPs; nullopt (the default) keeps the theme's button padding. The theme padding clips the icon of a small fixed-size icon button, such as a 40x40 title-bar back button, so pass [Thickness](../core/thickness.md){0} there. The button is measured again and redrawn.

### on_click

```cpp
void on_click(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Invoked on a completed click (mouse press and release inside, Enter/Space while focused, or UI Automation's Invoke) while enabled, before the command runs. The handler may destroy the button. Replaces any previous handler.

### set_flyout

```cpp
void set_flyout(FlyoutBase* flyout)
```

A click opens [`flyout`](#flyout) (and a second one closes it). Set for you when a [Button](#uibutton) becomes a [Flyout](flyout.md#uiflyout)'s anchor; the [Flyout](flyout.md#uiflyout) owns the [Button](#uibutton), so the pointer never outlives what it points at.

### flyout

```cpp
FlyoutBase* flyout() const
```

The flyout a click opens, or nullptr; owned by that flyout, not the button.

### set_command

```cpp
void set_command(CommandRef command, std::string parameter = {})
```

Runs [`command`](#command) with `parameter` on every click, after the click handler. The button is enabled only while the command is, and follows it as it changes; without a tooltip of its own it shows the command's description. Either may go first: a destroyed command leaves the button as if it had none. An empty ref clears it. A plain [Button](#uibutton) takes no label or icon from the command.

### command

```cpp
const Command* command() const
```

The command set with [set_command()](#set_command), or nullptr (none, or destroyed); not owned.

### command_parameter

```cpp
const std::string& command_parameter() const
```

The parameter passed to the command's execute.

### set_navigate_uri

```cpp
void set_navigate_uri(std::string uri)
```

Every click opens `uri` in its default handler, after the click handler and the command. Meant for ButtonVariant::Hyperlink, but works with any variant. Empty (the default) opens nothing.

### navigate_uri

```cpp
const std::string& navigate_uri() const
```

The URI a click opens, or empty.


True for a text button. A button with [content()](#content) answers false, because it measures the content without listing it in [for_each_child()](../tree/element.md#for_each_child) (the two share one tab stop).

Desired size = measured text (or [content()](#content)'s own [measure()](../tree/element.md#measure)) + padding, clamped to `available`; the padding is cached for [arrange_override()](#arrange_override).

Places [content()](#content) inside the padding [measure_override()](#measure_override) last used, centered.

Tracks hover and press; a release inside after a press inside is a click.

### render_override

```cpp

```

Emits: fill_rounded_rect (background) + draw_text (or the content), plus the theme's border where it draws one. A focus ring stroke is added only while focused and enabled.

Forwards the tick to [content()](#content), so animated content (an [AnimatedIcon](animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon), a [ProgressRing](progress-ring.md#uiprogressring)) keeps moving inside a button.

Runs on every completed click (pointer, Enter/Space, UI Automation's Invoke) before the click handler. [ToggleButton](toggle-button.md#uitogglebutton) flips its state here.

Performs a click as if the user completed one, when enabled: the flyout toggle, [on_activated()](#on_activated), on_click, the command, then [navigate_uri()](#navigate_uri).


Width kept free at the right of the content, inside the padding, for a trailing part the derived control draws itself: [DropdownButton](dropdown-button.md#uidropdownbutton)'s chevron column. The content (or the label) is laid out and centered in what is left.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp

```

Called by [Window](../tree/window.md). Losing focus cancels an Enter/Space press in progress. Redraws.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Enter or Space down presses the button, and up (while still focused) clicks it.

### automation_providers

```cpp
void automation_providers(AutomationProviders& out) override
```

Lists what a client can do with this node: set `out`'s field for each pattern this control implements now to `this`, through the provider interface it inherits privately (ui/Automation.hpp). A pattern that only applies in some states is an `if`. `out` arrives empty, and nothing is listed by default.

Example: 
```cpp
class Chip final : public ui::Element, private ui::InvokeProvider
{
protected:
    void automation_providers(ui::AutomationProviders& out) override
    {
        out.invoke = this;
    }

private:
    bool invoke() override
    {
        on_click_();
        return true;
    }
    ui::Callback<void()> on_click_;
};
```

## Enumerations

### ButtonVariant

```cpp
enum class ButtonVariant
```

Which of [Theme](../themes/theme.md)'s per-control token sets a [Button](#uibutton) draws with.

Example: 
```cpp
auto save = std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Save");
save->set_variant(ui::ButtonVariant::Accent); // the one high-emphasis action in the view
```

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Neutral` | The default look: a subtle translucent fill with an elevation border. |
| `Accent` | The filled, high-emphasis look, in the accent color. Use at most one per view. |
| `Subtle` | Borderless, showing only a wash on hover/press: toolbar, command-bar and menu buttons. |
| `Hyperlink` | A hyperlink button: Subtle's backgrounds under link-colored text, a Hand cursor, reported to UI Automation as a hyperlink, and opening [ButtonControl::navigate_uri()](#navigate_uri) when clicked. |
